implementation_statement: Access control policy POL-02 (P06) approved 2026-09-04 replaces the 2020 IT manual and covers OT. Procedures for OT account management are due 2026-12-31.

Business and cloud accounts are provisioned in the identity provider from HR tickets and disabled the same day for office staff. Gap: HMIs, SCADA, and the recipe system use shared operator accounts that are never revoked per person; no quarterly access review.
evidence: IdP user export; HMI account list

implementation_statement: The recipe system has operator, supervisor, and administrator roles. Gap: roles are held through shared accounts, so enforcement cannot be tied to a person.
Planned: formulation changes require a batching supervisor to propose and the FSQA Manager to approve (two-person rule) after named accounts are in place (2026-12-31).
Office users have no local admin rights. Gap: the integrator VPN account and the engineering laptop have full SCADA and PLC write access; the records application has a shared administrator.

The identity provider locks accounts for 15 minutes after 10 failed attempts. HMIs are exempt by design so operators are never locked out during a process upset; compensated by physical access control on the floor.
Office endpoints lock after 10 minutes. HMIs do not lock by design (operator visibility); shared production terminals lock after 15 minutes.

IT VPN requires MFA through the identity provider. Gap: the integrator uses a shared always-on VPN account into SCADA with no MFA, and the refrigeration contractor keeps an always-on cellular modem on the refrigeration controller. Planned: OT remote access gateway with MFA, per-session approval, and recording by 2026-10-31.
Corporate Wi-Fi uses WPA2-Enterprise. Gap: the cold-chain sensor gateway shares the corporate Wi-Fi; no separate IoT network.

Office staff complete annual security awareness training. Gap: production, sanitation, maintenance, and temporary workers receive none; food defense awareness for seafood room temporary workers lapsed in 2025.
Planned: role-based OT security training for the Controls Engineer, maintenance technicians, and the IT Technician (2027-03-31).
The identity provider, cloud tenant, and firewall log by default. Gap: the historian audit trail is disabled and HMI and recipe-system change events are not logged by user.
Historian records values with timestamps and tag names. Gap: no user identity on setpoint and recipe changes.

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: Gap: no log review. Planned: weekly review of identity, firewall, and remote-access logs by the IT Manager and daily review of recipe and setpoint change alerts by FSQA, starting 2026-11.
SCADA, historian, and PLCs synchronize time from the plant time server, which uses an external source through the firewall.

Gap: historian and records application entries can be edited by the shared administrator without a trail. Planned: audit trail on, record locking after sign-off, administrator separation (2026-12-31).
Records application data kept 2 years. Gap: identity, firewall, and cloud logs kept 30 to 90 days.
Audit generation enabled for identity, cloud, and firewall. Gap: not enabled on the historian or recipe system.
Control assessment performed 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-15 (P07).
Interconnections with the cloud tenant, ERP, WMS, and cold-chain SaaS are listed in this SSP. Gap: no interconnection terms with the controls integrator or refrigeration contractor.
Planned: monthly POA&M and food defense verification review by the General Manager with FSQA and IT, starting 2026-10.
Gap: no baseline configuration for PLCs, HMIs, or SCADA. Planned with the OT asset inventory (2026-11-30).
Gap: no OT change control. Planned: change procedure with FSQA sign-off for any change touching a CCP or an actionable process step, and a food defense reanalysis check (2026-12-31).
Gap: anyone with the shared engineering password can download PLC logic. Planned: PLC key switches in RUN, named engineering accounts, and program checksums (2026-12-31).
Office endpoints hardened through device management. Gap: OT hosts and the refrigeration controller not hardened; default password found on the refrigeration controller web interface (P07).
Unused services disabled on the SCADA server. Gap: HMIs run with USB ports enabled; the MES server is dual-homed.
Gap: no OT asset inventory. Office endpoints are inventoried in device management. Planned: OT inventory with firmware versions (2026-11-30).
Gap: no contingency plan for the PPCM. The BIA (P05) was approved 2026-09-04; the contingency plan with manual CCP monitoring and product hold procedures is due 2026-12-31.
Gap: OT and cloud backups never restore-tested. First restore test of SCADA and MES scheduled 2026-11-14 (sanitation window).

Nightly SCADA and MES backups to a network storage device; daily cloud backups. Gap: the storage device is domain-joined and in the same room; cloud backups share the production account; PLC programs are only on the engineering laptop.
Planned: recovery procedures, including verification of restored formulations against the signed master, in the contingency plan (2026-12-31).
All business and cloud users sign in with unique identities through the identity provider. Gap: shared accounts on HMIs, SCADA, the recipe system, and the records application administrator.
evidence: IdP user export; HMI account list

implementation_statement: MFA is required for privileged accounts in the identity provider and cloud console (phishing-resistant keys for the two cloud administrators). Gap: SCADA and engineering privileged access has no MFA.
Identity provider enforces length and banned-password rules. Gap: shared OT passwords unchanged for years; manufacturer default password on the refrigeration controller.
POL-03 Incident Response Policy approved 2026-09-04 (P06), including food safety decisions during cyber incidents.
Incidents are handled ad hoc by the IT Manager and the EDR vendor's managed detection service for office endpoints. The ransomware runbook (P08) was approved 2026-09-04; tabletop due 2026-12-15.
FSIS and FDA notification duties are in the P08 notification matrix. Gap: floor staff do not know how to report suspicious activity.
Incident response plan elements are documented in POL-03 and the P08 runbook.
Mechanical maintenance is logged in the maintenance system. Gap: controls and refrigeration software changes by contractors are not logged.
Remote maintenance occurs over the integrator VPN and refrigeration modem. Gap: no MFA, approval, or session record (see AC-17).
Gap: USB storage not restricted on HMIs or the engineering laptop. Planned: media scanning kiosk and USB blocking (2026-12-31).
Badge access to the plant, a locked cure and ingredient room, locked server room and engine room, CCTV at docks.
CCTV at docks and perimeter reviewed after events. Gap: no camera coverage of the seafood dip mixing area.
Standby generator carries refrigeration, SCADA, and the server room for about 72 hours; tested monthly.
This SSP.

baseline: Not in High baseline (selected by tailoring)
implementation_statement: The IT Manager is designated security lead for IT and OT in writing; the FSQA Manager is designated Food Defense Coordinator.
Office staff access removed the same day. Gap: production staff know shared OT passwords, which are not changed when they leave.
The PPCM is categorized High (integrity) in section 6 of this SSP.
Risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 with SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (P01) and fed into the food defense reanalysis.
Monthly authenticated scans of office endpoints and cloud workloads. Gap: no vulnerability identification for OT; passive OT asset discovery planned with the inventory.
Contracts exist with the cold-chain, AI vision, ERP, and WMS vendors. Gap: no security requirements or reviews for OT vendors; no SOC 2 reports reviewed before P09.
Gap: two HMIs run an unsupported operating system. Replacements quoted; isolation in the meantime.
A firewall separates the corporate and control networks. Gap: broad any-to-any rules for engineering, MES dual-homed on both networks, no OT DMZ. Planned: OT DMZ and rule rebuild (2027-03-31).
TLS 1.2 or higher to the cloud tenant, cold-chain SaaS, ERP, and WMS; site-to-cloud IPsec VPN for the historian replica.
Cloud and SaaS data encrypted at rest by the providers; office laptops encrypted.
Office endpoints patch automatically. Gap: OT hosts patched only during annual shutdown; PLC firmware not tracked.
EDR with managed detection on office endpoints. Gap: no malware protection on OT Windows hosts except the engineering laptop's antivirus.
Gap: no monitoring of the control network. Planned: OT endpoint protection and monitoring service, including alerts on setpoint and recipe changes (2027-01-31).
Planned: hash-verified recipe releases and PLC program checksums compared weekly with the approved baseline (2026-12-31).
HACCP records retained per 9 CFR 417.5(e) and food defense records per 21 CFR 121.315. Gap: records application retention settings not documented against both rules.
Planned: annual review of critical vendors' SOC 2 reports or questionnaires, starting with the cold-chain monitoring vendor (P09).
